reviews.t: Great oil for massages and salt scrubs
reviews.x: I purchased this apricot oil specifically to use for salt scrubs I make with essential oils for use on hands or during a shower or bath.  Apricot oil is one of my favorites to use in them because it isn't super thick and greasy and leaves just the right amount of moisture after you dry yourself off after using it in a scrub.  Additionally, it also makes a great massage oil.  Not a lot of fragrance to it and it works in nice without you having to wash your hands after use.  Love it!
As a massage therapist apricot oil is my choice, particularly for Face I mix with lavender oil. This brand i have ordered several times
I used to use an expensive moisturizer.  Now I use the pure apricot oil,day and night.  I love the way my skin feels!
Cheaper than in a store, very well packed, arrived on time, doesn`t make stain and very good for dry skin.

reviews.t: Okay moisturizer - keeps skin healthy but takes long time to absorb
reviews.x: I decided to try Life-Flo's apricot oil after using their avocado oil, which I love. I use it as I had read that apricot oil was supposed to be thinner than avo oil, but it felt way heavier (almost greasy) on my skin and took a lot longer to fully absorb! I'd end up smudging oil on things frequently, not a problem I had with avocado oil after the first 10-15 mins or so. I also prefer the smell of the avocado oil and the way my skin feels with it to the apricot oil. I'm a litte disappointed.  Jus

This oil is the truth!! It stopped my hair shedding completely!  My hair drinks oil and with olive oil, returned to dry and brittle.  Coconut oil irritated my scalp along with Jamaican black castor oil!  This oil makes my hair feel so moisture and conditioned.  I take a few drops per section. by rubbing hands together and applying from root to ends.  I can go 3 to 4 days before applying and hair still feels conditioned.

It is a lighter oil but it feels nice and smooth going on and does not have a strong smell.  I have severely dry skin therefore it was too light for me on my driest areas but in general it is a nice sheer oil.
While I have done much with this oil, yet; I was disappointed to find that it has no smell.  However, it is supposed to be good for the skin, so I will give it a shot.

reviews.t: It feels so good on my hair and softens it instantly
reviews.x: It feels so good on my hair and softens it instantly!  My hair was really dry earlier so I first sprayed my aloevera/water mixture and then applied some apricot oil on each section. I actually massaged it into my scalp, and used it as my oil treatment. It has no weird smell.

This oil makes my skin velvet soft. I use scrubbing glove and apply the oil on wet skin, then pat it down with a towel. My skin has never feel softer. I used coconut oil before but it didn't make my skin as soft as this apricot oil. It's fantastic for massages too!

reviews.t: This Light Oil is a Great Moisturizer
reviews.x: I love this pure apricot oil as a hydrating body oil.  After showering, I apply it all over my body and then towel off.  It seals in the moisture and leaves no oily feel to my skin, only softness. It keeps my tan from fading and my skin soft and itch free.

This oil is light and smooth. It works perfectly for infant massage without clogging pores. I don't have to worry that my baby is ingesting/absorbing something harmful, because this oil is plant-based and food-grade!
I use this on my baby every day and his skin is silky soft.  The smell is extremely faint and light so not to worry about any perfume smells.  Excellent oil for excema, rashes and dry skin.

reviews.t: This is a great product. My wife has very sensitive skin and ...
reviews.x: This is a great product. My wife has very sensitive skin and is allergic to many products. She is very pleased she can use this without any type of allergic reaction. Worth the money.
I love this as a carrier oil for carrot seed oil and a few others.....absorbs nicely into the skin. I highly recommend Life Flo's Rosehip seed oil, it's a must have also.
One word to describe this " Excellent"

I have tried various oils, not many but several. I bought fractionated coconut oil previously and it looked really good. It had no smell out of the bottle however, after being on your skin it started to have a noticeable unpleasant odor. I just bought this Apricot oil and I am so happy with this product. It looks and feel like high quality oil. I don't notice any smell to this oil. If there is one it is very faint if any. I had something like eczema around my nose. No lotions worked from Aquapho

It is one of my favorite oils as it is not sick, but moisturizes well. I use it for weekly hair mask, as a base for face application. I also add essential oils to it. It does not  smell and I can use it daily for skin oil cleansing , there is no need to go to commercial cleansers or body washes. I also use it for sugar scrubs and as a massage oil.  Since I do everything with my hands it also serves as a hand moisturizer

reviews.t: It is very nice. I switch between this product and coconut oil
reviews.x: This is the first time I have purchased apricot oil. I have not much to compare to. I have been placing on my body and face. It is very nice. I switch between this product and coconut oil. Does not have much of a smell either. Does not feel super oily. I really like. Was packed very well too. It came in very good condition, however if it had opened, my other items would have been protected well.

reviews.t: Extra soft skin and hair for me and my baby!
reviews.x: I use this on me and my babys hair and skin. We both are extra smooth and soft after using this! And this and other oils hold my babys curls better and her hair looks hydrated throughout the day and none frizzy where as other products i used held her curls and her hair looked hydrated til it dried than it would get frizzy and need more moisture.

I have skin problems and need to moisturize often with very emollient moisturizers.  The only thing I have a problem finding is a moisturizer for my scalp.  This makes a great moisturizer for that.  I put it on my scalp and hair before I go to sleep twice a week and shampoo it off in the morning.  It is not a cure but it does help a lot.

I tried some of this in a health food store and loved the way it moisturized my dry hands. The smell is nice and it absorbs quickly. You will see other brands or offers that are priced lower but the quality of this product is high and I don't think you will be dissapointed.

reviews.t: I know how good apricot seed kernels are for your body---vitamin b17 and ...
reviews.x: This oil can be drying compared to olive oil.  I know how good apricot seed kernels are for your body---vitamin b17 and cancer fighting.  So i was interested in using it in this oil form. It has very little smell so it will serve well as carrier oil but it is a lighter oil.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the oil for leaving skin soft and moisturized, including use on babies and dry skin.
Many reviewers find the oil light, smooth, and non-greasy, making it good for massage and body use.
Several reviewers value that it is food-grade, plant-based, and has little to no scent.
Some reviewers note it can feel heavier or greasy and take a long time to absorb, and one found it too light for severely dry areas.
A few reviewers report good results for hair, including reduced shedding and instant softening.
